findings.current: It had already been two weeks since Lei Fei had gone missing.
findings.defect: The draft changes the stated duration from fifteen days to fourteen days.
findings.rationale: 보름 specifically means fifteen days, not two weeks.
findings.replacement: It had already been fifteen days since Lei Fei had gone missing.

findings.current: “He told me to say that he loved you.”
findings.defect: The draft adds Wei Fenghu as the explicit object of Lei Fei’s love, although the source leaves both the recipient and object unstated.
findings.rationale: 전해 달라 asks Jin to pass the message along without specifying that Lei Fei meant Wei Fenghu alone.
findings.replacement: “He asked me to pass along his love.”

findings.current: They had held on to their weapons even while enduring the pain of having their limbs torn off.
findings.defect: The draft changes the injury mechanism from limbs being cut or severed to limbs being torn off.
findings.rationale: 잘려 나가다 denotes being cut or severed, not torn away.
findings.replacement: They had held on to their weapons even while enduring the pain of having their limbs severed.
findings.source: 사지가 잘려 나가는 고통 속에서도 손에 쥔 무기를 놓지 않을 만큼.

findings.current: The increase in my stats was so tiny that I could barely feel it.
findings.defect: The draft weakens an explicit negation into a barely perceptible sensation.
findings.rationale: 느껴지지도 않았다 states that he could not even feel the increase, which is reinforced by the following lake analogy.
findings.replacement: The increase in my stats was so tiny that I could not feel it at all.
findings.source: 올랐다는 능력치도 정말 쥐꼬리만큼이라 느껴지지도 않았다.

findings.current: If not, I would cut them down root and branch.
findings.defect: The draft turns Jin’s euphemistic weed-cutting image and trailing snipping punchline into a direct declaration that he will kill them.
findings.rationale: 삭초제근 sustains a weed-eradication metaphor, while 쓱싹 is a light cutting sound that supplies the joke’s deliberately indirect finish.
findings.replacement: If not, I’d cut the weeds out by the roots and—snip…
findings.source: 아니면 삭초제근(削草除根)한다는 마음가짐으로 쓱싹…….

findings.current: What the hell? I was only thinking about trying it.
findings.defect: The draft adds profanity and makes “it” sound like the sword test, rather than Jin protesting that his malicious idea was only a passing thought.
findings.rationale: 그냥 해 본 생각 refers to the preceding thought about eliminating people rejected by the sword; 어이없네 is an incredulous complaint rather than strong profanity.
findings.replacement: Come on. It was just a passing thought.

findings.current: “Mr. Jin. The Minister of State would like to see you.”
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicitly political and hierarchical address “Comrade.”
findings.rationale: 동지 is part of the official’s title and preserves the speaker’s formal Chinese political register.
findings.replacement: “Mr. Jin. Comrade Minister of State would like to see you.”

findings.current: A gigantic sinkhole, gaping open like the entrance to hell, and dozens of craters carved into the ground were filled with dark red and green blood.
findings.defect: The draft adds darkness to the blood’s color.
findings.rationale: 적녹색 specifies red and green; it does not describe the red as dark.
findings.replacement: A gigantic sinkhole, gaping open like the entrance to hell, and dozens of craters carved into the ground were filled with red and green blood.
findings.source: 지옥의 입구처럼 뻥 뚫린 거대한 싱크홀(Sinkhole)과 지면에 아로새겨진 수십 개의 크레이터에는 적녹색의 핏물이 가득 채워져 있었다.

findings.current: “The battle is over. There are no surviving monsters.”
findings.defect: The draft removes Jin’s marked pause before revealing that no monsters survived.
findings.rationale: The ellipsis after 살아남은 몬스터는 creates a deliberate hesitation and dramatic reveal that should be retained.
findings.replacement: “The battle is over. There are… no monsters left alive.”

findings.current: It was a famous sword whose chilling sharpness could be felt simply by looking at it.
findings.defect: “Famous” incorrectly implies that the sword is renowned rather than exceptionally fine.
findings.rationale: 명검 denotes an excellent or exceptional sword; the source does not state that it is famous.
findings.replacement: It was an exceptional sword whose chilling edge could be felt simply by looking at it.
findings.source: 보는 것만으로도 서늘한 예기(銳氣)가 느껴지는 명검이다.

findings.defect: The draft omits Jin’s comparison with his prior expectations.
findings.rationale: 생각보다 explicitly means that the sword is better than he had expected.

findings.current: He was usually a screw loose, but he was still a named monster and commander of the army of the dead.
findings.defect: “Was a screw loose” is not grammatical English for describing someone as scatterbrained or eccentric.
findings.rationale: The natural English idiom corresponding to 나사 빠진 놈 is “had a screw loose.”
findings.replacement: He usually had a screw loose, but he was still a named monster and commander of the army of the dead.
findings.source: 평소에는 나사 빠진 놈이지만 명색이 네임드 몬스터이자 망자 군단의 사령관이다.

summary: The draft contains four factual or semantic shifts, two meaningful register losses, and several localized wording issues.
